research_result.description: monday.com is a work management platform offering a GraphQL platform API and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integrating AI agents with platform data.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free developer sandbox account to obtain personal API tokens or create an app in the Developer Center to get client credentials (client ID and client secret) for OAuth 2.0 flows.

evidence.claim: monday.com supports OAuth 2.0 for app authorization.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account.

evidence.claim: monday.com OAuth tokens are bearer tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: All monday OAuth tokens are *bearer* tokens.

evidence.claim: monday.com offers free developer accounts for testing and building apps.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A developer account (also called a sandbox account) is a free monday.com account designed for building and testing monday apps and API integrations.

evidence.claim: The monday.com platform API is built on GraphQL rather than REST.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The monday.com API is built with GraphQL, a flexible query language that allows you to return as much or as little data as you need.

evidence.claim: monday.com provides an officially maintained hosted MCP server for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Platform MCP is monday.com's hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, maintained by the monday.com AI team.
